BROOKS MEADOWS ADMINISTRATIVE SITE
(Within Oregon National Forest)
OREGON
Under authority of the Act of Congress approved June 25, 1910 (36
Stat., 847), as amended by the act of August 24, 1912 (37 Stat., 497), and
on the recommendation of the Secretary of Agriculture, it is hereby ordered
that the following described tract of unsurveyed land, containing approxi-
